recurring.title: Recurring items
recurring.subtitle: A recurring item is a recipe, not an item. Each one creates a real entry on its own schedule — the daily standup note, the monthly capacity report, the quarterly review.
recurring.scheduleHint: The schedule runs once a night at 03:15 UTC and again whenever someone opens the app, so a missed night catches up on the first visit of the day.
recurring.leadExplainer: An item appears on its run date and is due a few days later. Zero days means it is due the day it appears.
recurring.emptyBody: Set up the work that comes back every week or every month, and it will be waiting in follow-ups instead of in somebody's memory.
recurring.fieldTitleHint: Every item this creates will carry this title.
recurring.intervalHint: Counted from one run to the next, not from the start of a week or a month.
recurring.dayOfWeekHint: Every run after the first lands on this day.
recurring.dayOfMonthHint: Stored on the item, so a run clamped to a short month recovers afterwards.
recurring.dayOfMonthClamp: A month too short for it clamps to its last day: 31 becomes 28 in February, then 31 again in March.
recurring.firstRunHint: The day the first item is created. Everything after it follows the cadence.
recurring.clamped: That day has already passed, so the first run moved forward to {date} — same rhythm, no backdated items.
recurring.alignPrompt: The first run is a {from}. Move it to {date} so it starts on a {target}?
recurring.leadDays: Due this many days after it appears
recurring.leadHint: Zero means due the day it appears. Three gives whoever owns it three days of warning.
recurring.previewHint: Left: the day the item is created. Right: the day it is due.
recurring.previewNone: Pick a valid first run to preview the schedule.
recurring.trackArchivedHint: An archived track stops its recurring items. Restore the track and the schedule resumes, including the runs it missed.
recurring.behindBody: The next pass will create every one of them. Skip ahead to keep only the next run.
recurring.behindCapped: One pass creates at most {cap} items, so a long gap catches up over several days.
recurring.skipNothingToast: Nothing to skip — this one isn't behind.
recurring.runNowHint: Creates one item dated today. Running it twice in a day creates nothing the second time.
recurring.pausedToast: Paused. Nothing is created until you resume it.
recurring.deleteBody: The recipe goes. Nothing has been created from it yet.

deleteBodyWithEntries.one: The recipe goes. The 1 item it already created stays, and stops naming this schedule.
deleteBodyWithEntries.other: The recipe goes. The {count} items it already created stay, and stop naming this schedule.

recurring.deleteAdminOnly: Only an admin can delete a recurring item. Pausing it is available to everyone.
recurring.discardBody: The edits to this recurring item haven't been saved.
recurring.errTitleRequired: Give it a title — that is what every item it creates will be called.
recurring.errNotFound: That recurring item is gone — someone else deleted it.
